dialogues.jp:
月城の育てている草の様子を見ようと、足を運
んだところで、ちょうど月城に出会った。
dialogues.en:
On the way to checking on Alice's plant, I bumped into the
aforementioned there.
dialogues.text:
On the way to checking on Alice's plant, I bumped into the
aforementioned there.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ、もう終わりか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, you're done already?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, you're done already?"

dialogues.jp:
手には空になったじょうろを持っており、彼女
の後ろの方には、キラキラと葉を輝かせている
例の草があった。
dialogues.en:
She held an empty water can in her hands. In front of her,
the plant had drops of water still residuant, sparkling.
dialogues.text:
She held an empty water can in her hands. In front of her,
the plant had drops of water still residuant, sparkling.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、ここへ来た意味がなかったな……」
dialogues.en: "There goes my reason for being here then..."
dialogues.text: "There goes my reason for being here then..."

dialogues.jp:
さて、どうしたものかと、頭をかく。このまま
月城と別れてしまうのはちょっとつまらない。
dialogues.en:
I started to scratch my head. Now what should I do... I
don't really want to just leave like this.
dialogues.text:
I started to scratch my head. Now what should I do... I
don't really want to just leave like this.

dialogues.jp:
草も気になっているが、月城本人のことも気に
なっているのだから。
dialogues.en:
Partly because of the plant, but more importantly, because
of Tsukishiro herself.
dialogues.text:
Partly because of the plant, but more importantly, because
of Tsukishiro herself.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだ、月城。メシはもう食ったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah. Tsukishiro, have you eaten yet?"
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah. Tsukishiro, have you eaten yet?"

dialogues.jp: ふるふると首を横に振る月城。
dialogues.en: Her hair shook along with her head, no.
dialogues.text: Her hair shook along with her head, no.

dialogues.jp:
「俺もまだなんだが、学食へ行って、一緒に飯
　でも食わないか？」
dialogues.en:
"I haven't either. Want to eat lunch at the cafeteria
together?"
dialogues.text:
"I haven't either. Want to eat lunch at the cafeteria
together?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、何かを考えているのか、右へ首を傾げ、
左へ首を傾げ、しばらくして、
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, thinking hard about it, tilted her head left and
right alternately, until eventually,
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, thinking hard about it, tilted her head left and
right alternately, until eventually,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: と答えた。
dialogues.en: She answered.
dialogues.text: She answered.

dialogues.jp:
もう少し、感情豊かに喋ってくれれば嬉しいん
だけど、そうもいかないようだ。
dialogues.en: Little by little, she was starting to open up.
dialogues.text: Little by little, she was starting to open up.

dialogues.jp:
俺が、カツカレーを頼むと、奇遇にも月城はカ
レーライスを頼んでいた。
dialogues.en:
I ordered the curry pork, and my unexpected lunch companion
ordered the curry rice.
dialogues.text:
I ordered the curry pork, and my unexpected lunch companion
ordered the curry rice.

dialogues.jp: 「へぇ、月城もカレーか」
dialogues.en: "Heeh, you like curry too?"
dialogues.text: "Heeh, you like curry too?"

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: The usual, quick nod.
dialogues.text: The usual, quick nod.

dialogues.jp: テーブルについて、食事をする俺と月城。
dialogues.en: We found a table, and started digging in.
dialogues.text: We found a table, and started digging in.

dialogues.jp:
人形を隣の席に座らせ、さすがに手袋は取って
食事をしていた。
dialogues.en:
Her doll and gloves were both placed on the seat next to
her.
dialogues.text:
Her doll and gloves were both placed on the seat next to
her.

dialogues.jp: 手袋は、人形を持つための道具……なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
It seems like the gloves help her carry the doll... or
something.
dialogues.text:
It seems like the gloves help her carry the doll... or
something.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、月城があまり喋らないものだか
ら、会話ははっきりいって盛り上がらない。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro still wasn't used to talking idly, so her
sentences were often short and direct.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro still wasn't used to talking idly, so her
sentences were often short and direct.

dialogues.jp: けど、それはそれでよかった。
dialogues.en: But, that she's even trying, is a blessing.
dialogues.text: But, that she's even trying, is a blessing.

dialogues.jp:
「テスト、できたか？　俺の方はサッパリだっ
　たよ」
dialogues.en: "How were your tests? I'm glad mine are over."
dialogues.text: "How were your tests? I'm glad mine are over."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……テストは、できました」
dialogues.en: "...I think I did fine."
dialogues.text: "...I think I did fine."

dialogues.jp:
小さな口で、カレーをもぐもぐと食べている様
はなんだかとても可愛らしい。
dialogues.en:
Seeing that tiny mouth nibble on the curry rice was just
adorable.
dialogues.text:
Seeing that tiny mouth nibble on the curry rice was just
adorable.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、思わずライスの部分に旗を立ててあ
げたい気分だ。
dialogues.en: The nearly untouched rice portion reminded me of something.
dialogues.text: The nearly untouched rice portion reminded me of something.

dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、月城って……プリン好きだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tsukishiro... do you like pudding?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tsukishiro... do you like pudding?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、｛いぶか／訝｝しげに俺を見るが、しばらくして、
なぜか照れくさそうに、
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro looked at me suspiciously. After some thought,
and with a slight blush,
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro looked at me suspiciously. After some thought,
and with a slight blush,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……好きです」
dialogues.en: "...Yes I do."
dialogues.text: "...Yes I do."

dialogues.jp: と答えた。
dialogues.en: She answered.
dialogues.text: She answered.

dialogues.jp:
「カッププリンは、絶対お皿にひっくり返して
　食べてるだろ」
dialogues.en:
"I bet you turn it upside down before you start eating,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"I bet you turn it upside down before you start eating,
right?"

dialogues.jp: 月城はさらに照れくさそうに下を向いた。
dialogues.en: The embarassment on her face was clear now.
dialogues.text: The embarassment on her face was clear now.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、やっぱりだ……。
dialogues.en: Aha, ahahaha...
dialogues.text: Aha, ahahaha...

dialogues.jp: そうだと思ったよ。
dialogues.en: I knew it.
dialogues.text: I knew it.

dialogues.jp: 「今度、俺と一緒にシャボン玉でも作ろうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Next time, let's make those soap bubbles together~"
dialogues.text: "Next time, let's make those soap bubbles together~"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、何かを考えているのか、右へ首を傾げ、
左へ首を傾げ、しばらくして、
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, thinking about something, tilted her head left
and right again.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, thinking about something, tilted her head left
and right again.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……飲んじゃうので、ヤです」
dialogues.en: "...I don't want to drink it."
dialogues.text: "...I don't want to drink it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「最近のは、吸い込み防止機能がついてるから」
dialogues.en:
"There's some safety functions and stuff that prevent that
from happening nowadays."
dialogues.text:
"There's some safety functions and stuff that prevent that
from happening nowadays."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……それなら」

月城は、さっきと同じように、頬を赤らめなが
ら俯いていた。
dialogues.en:
Just like before, she hung her head low, her cheeks flushed
with redness.
dialogues.text:
Just like before, she hung her head low, her cheeks flushed
with redness.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あー、朝倉先輩と、月城さんじゃないですか。
　こんなところで一緒に食事ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Ahhh, it's Asakura-senpai and Tsukishiro-san! Are you
eating lunch together?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahhh, it's Asakura-senpai and Tsukishiro-san! Are you
eating lunch together?"

dialogues.jp:
美春が、俺達の隣のテーブルにどっかりと腰を
下ろす。
dialogues.en: Miharu was sitting down at the table right next to ours.
dialogues.text: Miharu was sitting down at the table right next to ours.

dialogues.jp:
そして、一緒に来ていた友達も、テーブルに着
いた。
dialogues.en: Her arriving friends followed suit.
dialogues.text: Her arriving friends followed suit.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「へぇ、先輩達もカレーですか。カレーはいい
　ですよね」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, everyone's eating curry, it must taste good today!"
dialogues.text: "Hehe, everyone's eating curry, it must taste good today!"

dialogues.jp: 美春がそう言って笑う。
dialogues.en: Miharu giggled at her own sentence.
dialogues.text: Miharu giggled at her own sentence.

dialogues.jp:
よく見ると、美春だけでなく、彼女の友達ふた
りもカレーを頼んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Looking closely, it isn't just Miharu, but her two friends
as well, who had ordered something curry-related.
dialogues.text:
Looking closely, it isn't just Miharu, but her two friends
as well, who had ordered something curry-related.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、ここだけインドみたいですね！」
dialogues.en: "It's like we're living in India right now!"
dialogues.text: "It's like we're living in India right now!"

dialogues.jp:
短絡的な発想だな……。どう見ても日本のカレー
じゃないか。
dialogues.en:
This is Japanese curry anyway... which made me notice
something weird about hers.
dialogues.text:
This is Japanese curry anyway... which made me notice
something weird about hers.

dialogues.jp: 「……お前のカレー、なんだよ、それ」
dialogues.en: "...What's that you're eating with the curry?"
dialogues.text: "...What's that you're eating with the curry?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はえ？　バナナカレーじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Haeh? It's banana curry."
dialogues.text: "Haeh? It's banana curry."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「バ、バナナカレー……。よくそんな気色悪い
　もの食ってるな……」
dialogues.en: "Ba, banana curry... you must have a stomach of steel..."
dialogues.text: "Ba, banana curry... you must have a stomach of steel..."

dialogues.jp:
美春の向かいに座った友達が、よくぞ言ってく
れたと言わんばかりに大きく頷いている。
dialogues.en:
The girls sitting across from Miharu, hearing me say what
they didn't have the heart to, nodded their agreement.
dialogues.text:
The girls sitting across from Miharu, hearing me say what
they didn't have the heart to, nodded their agreement.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「失礼な。バナナカレーは、専門店にもある立
　派なトッピングですよ。ぴりりと辛いカレー
　にほのかなバナナの甘みが……」
dialogues.en:
"Well excuse me! Banana curry is an exquisite dish! The
spiciness of curry mixed with the sweetness of banana..."
dialogues.text:
"Well excuse me! Banana curry is an exquisite dish! The
spiciness of curry mixed with the sweetness of banana..."

dialogues.jp:
美春は瞳をうっとりと潤ませていた。相変わら
ず、なんでもバナナなヤツだな。
dialogues.en: Her eyes started sparkling. Her and her banana fetish...
dialogues.text: Her eyes started sparkling. Her and her banana fetish...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「──月城さんは、普通のカレーですね」
dialogues.en: "--Ah, Tsukishiro-san's eating normal curry."
dialogues.text: "--Ah, Tsukishiro-san's eating normal curry."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、テンションの高い美春に若干戸惑いな
がらそう答えた。
dialogues.en:
With tension in the air, Tsukishiro answered the
stll-high-strung Miharu.
dialogues.text:
With tension in the air, Tsukishiro answered the
stll-high-strung Miharu.

dialogues.jp:
その時、美春の耳がわんこのようにぴくんと反
応する。
dialogues.en: Miharu's ears suddenly perked up like a puppy dog.
dialogues.text: Miharu's ears suddenly perked up like a puppy dog.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さん、ひとつ聞いていいですか……？
　そのカレーって、やっぱり甘口ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro-san, can I ask a question...? That curry, is it
the sweet type?"
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro-san, can I ask a question...? That curry, is it
the sweet type?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……はい、甘口です」
dialogues.en: "...Yes, it's sweet."
dialogues.text: "...Yes, it's sweet."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり！　やっぱりそうですよね！」
dialogues.en: "I knew it! I knew it had to be!"
dialogues.text: "I knew it! I knew it had to be!"

dialogues.jp:
美春が、妙にウキウキ気分のテンションで、ニ
ヤつきながら、そう言った。
dialogues.en:
Her innocently cheerful smile was enough to chase away the
tension.
dialogues.text:
Her innocently cheerful smile was enough to chase away the
tension.

dialogues.jp: そして、やたらと嬉しそうに、
dialogues.en: Speaking again, with much more joy in her words,
dialogues.text: Speaking again, with much more joy in her words,

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あの、あの、もうひとつ聞いていいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, hey, can I ask another question?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey, can I ask another question?"

dialogues.jp: 月城がおそるおそるこくんと頷く。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro, half-frightened, couldn't do much besides nod.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro, half-frightened, couldn't do much besides nod.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱりプリンは──」
dialogues.en: "Then I bet you eat pudding--"
dialogues.text: "Then I bet you eat pudding--"

dialogues.jp:
この時、俺と美春の頭の中身は多分おなじもの
でできてるんだと確信した。
dialogues.en:
At that moment, I was convinced that Miharu and I had the
same angle in mind.
dialogues.text:
At that moment, I was convinced that Miharu and I had the
same angle in mind.

dialogues.jp: ◆お子様ランチ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lunch with the Mistress◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lunch with the Mistress◆

dialogues.jp:
俺と月城は、一緒に学食で昼食を取ることにし
た。彼女と俺は同じようにカレーを頼んだのだ
が、カレーと彼女の似合うこと！
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro and I ended up eating lunch together. We both
ended up curry, but it seemed far more suited to her!
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro and I ended up eating lunch together. We both
ended up curry, but it seemed far more suited to her!

dialogues.jp:
小さな口で、カレーをもぐもぐ食べている様は
なんだか旗でも立ててあげたい気分になる。
dialogues.en:
Seeing that tiny mouth nibble on the curry rice was just
adorable.
dialogues.text:
Seeing that tiny mouth nibble on the curry rice was just
adorable.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん甘口。しかもプリンは必ずお皿にひっ
くり返して食べるらしい。シャボン玉は好きだ
けど、時々液を飲んでしまうみたいだし。
dialogues.en:
Of course, it was sweet. And she turned her pudding upside
down before eating it. And she liked blowing bubbles, but
would occasionally swallow them.
dialogues.text:
Of course, it was sweet. And she turned her pudding upside
down before eating it. And she liked blowing bubbles, but
would occasionally swallow them.

dialogues.jp: ……かわいいなぁ。
dialogues.en: ...Sooooo cute.
dialogues.text: ...Sooooo cute.
